title: Chicken Paella
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.
Place paella pan on the stove over high heat. Add olive oil and heat until shimmering.
Season chicken with ½ tsp of kosher salt. Sear until golden brown, about 4 minutes.
Add mushrooms and saute until tender, about 1 minute.
Add rice, sofrito, and 3 tsp of kosher salt. Stir rice for 30 seconds until all the ingredients are fully combined.

Add chicken stock, saffron water, and picada, stirring to make sure all the flavors blend well. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium. The stock should be boiling moderately at this point, with small even bubbles all over, 5-10mm in size.
Cook until the stock reduces to even with the rice, approximately 10 minutes.
Transfer the paella pan to the oven and cook until rice is slightly softer than al dente, approximately 9-12 minutes. Oven times may vary.
Halfway through the oven process, top the paella with the artichoke confit.
Remove the paella from the oven and allow it to rest for 4 minutes. Sprinkle the green peas evenly over top while resting.
reviewFlags: The source lists conflicting volume and weight measurements for several ingredients, including the chicken, rice, stock, saffron water, and picada. Confirm which measurements to use.
